name: Permitext NYC Zoning Research candidate batch 1 intake

ownerReview.scope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off, public Zoning Research release, paid-run authorization, pricing authorization, deployment authorization, or permission to alter the original 21-case benchmark.

governance.notes: The owner approved nine reviewed candidates for a separate expanded evaluation cohort. ChatGPT's READY labels were not adopted automatically. Cases 1, 3, and 11 remain held, the original 21-case benchmark remains immutable, and paid evaluation remains locked.

verification.readinessInterpretation: A missing address, BBL, map location, DOB record, or historical zoning-lot record may be the deliberate fact gap an evaluation case is meant to test. Source-declared BLOCKED therefore does not automatically mean the evaluation case itself is unusable.

cases.title: R8A mixed-use development relying on an unverified affordable-housing FAR
cases.reason: The source boundary is sound, but the case broadly overlaps the frozen missing-location and affordable-FAR cases. Narrow the rubric to mixed-use FAR and commercial-mapping interaction before promotion.

cases.title: R6A UAP proposal with insufficient affordable floor area
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The one-for-one UAP increment, table ceiling, and 800-square-foot shortfall are supported by current official text.

cases.title: Market-rate R7A building incorrectly using the qualifying height limit
cases.reason: The legal answer and 20-foot excess are correct, but the frozen benchmark already tests the same R7A standard-versus-qualifying height-column selection.

cases.title: Insufficient rear yard equivalent on a deep through lot
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: This adds a useful vertical rule change at 75 feet beyond the frozen shallow-lot case; the 10-foot and 30-foot deficiencies are supported.

cases.title: R6 parking requirement based on an unverified transit-zone claim
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only as an explicit-uncertainty case; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The missing map is the intended uncertainty. The official text supports the three conditional outcomes: zero, zero through the 15-space waiver, or 30 spaces.

cases.title: Improper stacking of residential and manufacturing FAR in an MX district
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The non-additive total-FAR rule and 4,900-square-foot excess are supported and materially broaden the benchmark.

cases.title: Claimed as-of-right 25 percent enlargement of a nonconforming warehouse
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The case correctly separates continuation, district-limited as-of-right enlargement, and the conditional BSA special-permit route.

cases.title: Residential FAR calculation on a zoning lot split between R7A and R8A
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The 5.212 weighted FAR and 5,760-square-foot excess are supported and distinct from the frozen use-regulation boundary case.

cases.title: Conversion of a pre-1991 C6-2 office building to 100 apartments
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The current text supports the 133-unit preliminary maximum and 2,700- or conditional 1,800-square-foot recreation calculation. Non-zoning approval remains expressly outside the case.

cases.title: City of Yes transition claim based on a pre-amendment permit and incomplete foundations
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only as an explicit-uncertainty case; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: Current Section 11-333(9) supports the separate transition route. DOB records and historical substantive text are deliberately required before a project-specific conclusion.

cases.title: Unverified 120-foot height in the Special Downtown Far Rockaway District
cases.reason: The text correctly rejects a district-wide 155-foot entitlement, but selecting the controlling maximum requires the incorporated Map 4 or Map 5 and a known property location.

cases.title: MIH small-development exception and a zoning lot assembled after MIH establishment
cases.approvalScope: Evaluation testing only as an explicit-uncertainty case; not professional zoning sign-off or public-release authorization.
cases.reason: The numerical elements are supported, while the exception correctly remains unresolved until the MIH establishment date and historical zoning-lot configuration are verified.
